changes: Adds a portable, secret-classified arrayref::Kem implementation for ML-KEM-512/768/1024. Randomness, CPA private keys, messages, coins, implicit-rejection values, selectors, and shared secrets remain libcrux-secrets values through SHA-3, sampling, polynomial encoding, re-encryption, and selection. Only specified public outputs and the public-key subsection embedded in a decapsulation key are declassified. Existing released APIs and malformed-input behavior remain present.
